en.name: Arthur
en.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. The 1st time Arthur attacks a Minion, Arthur swaps characters with them, and 2 alive players are attacked instead.

zh.name: 亚瑟
zh.ability: 每个夜晚*，你要选择一名玩家：他死亡。当亚瑟首次攻击爪牙时，亚瑟会与其交换角色，且两名存活玩家代替其被攻击。
